jobs.description:
Job description 

Our client in the Kortrijk/Menen region is looking for CE drivers for transporting sea containers. Usually for picking up and dropping off, but sometimes also just unloading at the quay. Nice working days of approximately 12 hours and home every day.

Loading and unloading locations at terminals in the ports of Ghent/Antwerp and at the client's warehouses and companies.

 Requirements 

You are motivated to work in the ports. You have a valid CE driving license with C95.

You have a good knowledge of Dutch, English, or French.

You live in the Kortrijk/Westhoek region.

Job description 

The Adventures of an International Driver
 Are you ready to take the wheel and turn every trip into an adventure? As an international driver, you’ll be transporting goods all across Europe—think the Netherlands, Germany, Luxembourg, and France—behind the wheel of a sleek tarpaulin truck.

From candy to concrete, meat to zinc on pallets, no two loads are ever the same. It’s like a market of surprises—just with more driving and fewer small talk breaks!

Planning and timing are your superpowers. You’ll keep trips efficient, respect driving and rest rules, and make sure every delivery reaches its destination perfectly. Customers? Think of them as friends—you’ll want to impress every single one.

Flexibility and independence are key. Unexpected challenges? You handle them like a pro. One thing’s for sure: life as an international driver is never boring, always full of variety, and packed with adventure.

 Requirements 

Driving License CE + Code 95 Reliable, Flexible

I can communicate in Dutch, French, and English. That's convenient, right? No language barriers here, just a glass wall full of fun!

Job description 

Love driving? We’re looking for a CE truck driver for day trips transporting pallets—full or empty, you’ll handle them all!

    
• 
        
Early start: 4–6 a.m.

    
    
• 
        
Average driving: 10–13 hours/day

    
    
• 
        
2–5 stops daily – build great client relationships

    
    
• 
        
No loading/unloading – technical support provided

    
    
• 
        
Work area: Belgium, S. Netherlands, W. Germany & N. France

    
    
• 
        
Shadow an experienced driver on your first day for a smooth start

    

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, we provide the guidance you need.

Apply now and join our team!

 Requirements 

Your profile To be successful in this role, you meet the following requirements:

    
• Papers: You possess a valid CE driving license and up-to-date Code 95.
    
• Language skills: You can express yourself fluently in Dutch, French, and English. This is essential for communication during international stops.
    
• Reliability: You are punctual, keep appointments, and handle equipment with care.
    
• Technical skills: Do you already have experience with the Transics black box? Then you have an advantage!
    
• Attitude: You are an early bird who can work independently.

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver with On-Board Forklift (Moffett)
jobs.description:
Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.

Job description 
 What will you do? 
    
• 
        
Play the early bird: The road is yours while the rest of the world is still hitting snooze.

    
    
• 
        
Embrace variety: Shuttle between regional clients carrying agricultural products, sand, gravel, or waste (no ADR stress!).

    
    
• 
        
Be versatile: Switch smoothly between a tipper and a curtain-sider like it's nothing.

    
    
• 
        
Build some muscle: A physical challenge doesn't scare you off.

    

 Requirements 
 Who are you? 
    
• 
        
You hold a CE License + Code 95 (crucial, otherwise things get awkward with the police).

    
    
• 
        
You speak Dutch, French, or English (as long as we can understand each other by the coffee machine).

    
    
• 
        
You are flexible, precise, and treat your truck as if it were your own.

    
    
• 
        
Want extra hours? Great! More hours = more cash.

Job description 

Looking for freedom and your own dedicated truck (after your onboarding period)? This is your route:

    
• 
        
What: National transport (tipper and curtain-sider) of steel and miscellaneous materials.

    
    
• 
        
When: Early mornings (start between 4 AM and 6 AM) for a full 10-12 hour day.

    
    
• 
        
How: Independently, punctually, and in close contact with dispatch.

    

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
Valid CE license + Code 95.

    
    
• 
        
Speaks Dutch, French, or English.

    
    
• 
        
An early bird who loves working independently and accurately.

    
    
• 
        
An honest team player who cares for the equipment and the customer.

Job description 

As our new Distribution Driver, you will deliver goods on euro-pallets to clients within your region. No heavy lifting required—you’ll be using an electric pallet jack!

    
• 
        
Hours: Full-time, averaging 10 hours per day.

    
    
• 
        
Schedule: Monday to Friday (weekends off).

    
    
• 
        
Stops: 15 to 25 customer deliveries per day.

    
    
• 
        
Start time: 07:00 AM.

    
    
• 
        
Region: Mainly West Flanders, with occasional trips to East Flanders and Wallonia.

    

 

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
Valid Category C driving license.

    
    
• 
        
Based near Gullegem.

    
    
• 
        
Experience in distribution is a major plus.

    
    
• 
        
Flexible enough to occasionally drive a delivery van.

    
    
• 
        
Independent, proactive, safety-conscious, and customer-friendly.

    
    
• 
        
Fluent in Dutch, French, or English.

Job description 

Due to expansion, several modern trucks are ready for new drivers to embark on international journeys!

Join our family-owned company where safety, reliability, and professionalism come first.

Your Role:

    
• 
        
Conduct international transport across the Benelux, Germany, and France.

    
    
• 
        
Handle specialized cargo, such as heated liquids.

    
    
• 
        
Work primarily Monday morning to Friday evening, with occasional rotational weekends.

    
    
• 
        
Opportunities for national day trips in some cases.

    

Requirements:

    
• 
        
ADR certification is mandatory.

    
    
• 
        
Previous driving experience.

    
    
• 
        
Strong sense of responsibility and reliability.

    

What We Offer:

    
• 
        
Full-time, 6-day schedule with all hours fairly compensated.

    
    
• 
        
Thorough training and supervision during the first 6 months.

    
    
• 
        
Permanent contract after a successful probationary period.

    
    
• 
        
Modern, well-equipped trucks and a supportive work environment.

    

Interested?
 Quick responses mean a quick start! If you have any questions about the position, don’t hesitate to contact us.

 Requirements 

We are looking for a motivated professional who meets the following requirements:

    
• Driver's License CE: You must possess a valid CE driver's license.
    
• ADR Tank: You have a valid ADR tank certificate.
    
• Experience: You have experience as an international CE driver.
    
• Accuracy and Safety-Conscious: You work accurately and have a strong focus on safety.
    
• Willingness to Work: You are willing to work two weeks per month.
    
• Language Skills: You have a good command of Dutch and/or English.

If this appeals to you, we warmly invite you to apply!

jobs.occupation: Start as a C Driver and grow into CE
jobs.description:
Job description 
As a C driver at our company, you will start by transporting construction materials and machinery. This is done using different types of trucks, such as box trucks and crane trucks. You will not always be required to load and unload the cargo yourself, but occasionally your assistance may be needed. Do you have experience with a loading crane? That’s a plus! But don’t worry if you don’t, as you will receive internal training. If you already hold a C driving license, you also have the opportunity to progress to CE. This is your chance to further develop your career in the transport sector! What are you waiting for? Join our team and give your career a boost!

 Requirements 
  Start as a C Driver and Grow into CE Have you ever dreamed of hitting the road while taking your career to the next level? Then this is your chance! Start as a C driver and explore the opportunities to grow into a CE driver. Language skills In this role, it is important to have a good command of Dutch, French, and/or English. This not only helps in communication with customers but also broadens your opportunities in an increasingly international environment. Motivation to learn crane work We also offer you the opportunity to learn crane operation. Why let this chance pass you by? These additional skills increase your value on the job market and make you indispensable for future employers. It is not only an investment in your career, but also in your personal development. Why wait? Seize this opportunity to build a successful career as a driver. Now is the perfect time to take the step toward a challenging and rewarding future full of growth and new experiences. Take that first step today!

 As a CE driver, you will handle international refrigerated transport throughout Europe, with varied trips and a schedule that brings diversity to your workweek. 
You will be driving to:

    
• Benelux
    
• France
    
• Spain
    
• Switzerland

• CE driving licence with valid certificates
    
• Good knowledge of Dutch or English
    
• Flexible regarding working hours and overnight stays
    
• Able to work independently as a driver

 What can you expect from us? 
    
• Competitive salary supplemented with extra benefits
    
• Well-maintained equipment, a respectful approach, job security, and plenty of freedom on the road

Job description 

You will be responsible for delivering meat to companies, distribution centers, or supermarkets with a refrigerated trailer.

Possibility of driving shuttles between the customer and distribution centers.

Loading at the processor and 2 to 3 stops per day. Unloading at the dock or using the loading bridge and electric pallet truck.

Working from Monday to Friday.

 

 Requirements 

    
• CE driver's license with a valid C95.
    
• You have initial experience in refrigerated transport.
    
• You are Dutch or speak English well.
    
• Shifts from 10 to 13 hours per day.
    
• Good, open communication with planning/management.

Are you ready to shape the future of defense systems? Located in Liège, this opportunity offers a chance to lead groundbreaking advancements in system engineering. As Head of Systems Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in transforming complex defense technologies into modular, software-centric solutions that redefine industry standards. Join a dynamic sector where your expertise will drive progress and make an impact.

 

 

 

As the Head of Systems Engineering, you will be responsible for ensuring technical excellence across all aspects of system architecture, integration, industrialization, and lifecycle support. Your leadership will be instrumental in transitioning from product-focused operations to integrated, modular systems that prioritize execution and innovation. Key responsibilities include:

• System Architecture Mastery: Define and oversee reference architectures (mechanical, electronic, software, interfaces) while ensuring seamless integration between effectors, sensors, embedded software, connectivity, and lifecycle support requirements.
• Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Act as the de facto Head of System Engineering, making critical technical decisions across the portfolio and serving as the authority for programs, production teams, technology partners, and demanding military clients.
• Software & Robotic Systems Development: Establish software as a core industrial pillar by advancing practices in real-time robotics, control-command systems, safety-critical software, and cyber resilience. Promote simulation tools, digital twins, automated testing, and continuous integration tailored to high-stakes environments.
• Execution & Industrialization: Ensure architectural choices are scalable for mass production while maintaining cost efficiency. Collaborate closely with production departments, supply chain teams, quality assurance units, and lifecycle support experts to avoid prototype stagnation.
• Technological Partnerships: Drive strategic partnerships in areas such as sensors, counter-UAS systems, autonomy software, and more. Integrate external components seamlessly without compromising system integrity.

To excel in this role as Technical Director - Systems Engineering you should bring:

• Experience:
• 15+ years in engineering complex systems.
• Background in performance robotics (e.g., military/security robotics, drones/autonomous systems, critical industrial robotics).
• Proven track record in hardware/software integration, multi-disciplinary systems development, serial production implementation, and long lifecycle management within certified/safety-critical environments.
• Fluency in French and English is a must.
• Key Technical Skills:
• Expertise in system engineering with a holistic approach.
• Proficiency in mechatronic architectures, embedded electronics design, real-time software/middleware/communication frameworks.
• Deep understanding of trade-offs between performance vs. cost, sophistication vs. robustness, and innovation vs. industrialization.
• Leadership Qualities:
• Strategic technical leadership with decision-making authority.
• Ability to standardize processes and confidently say "no" when necessary.
• Comfortable navigating constrained industrial environments with exposure to demanding clients like armed forces.
• Credibility among senior engineers, program managers, and high-level technology partners.

What will you do?

What does your day look like as a truck driver with a Moffett?

  • You start early in the morning (between 5 AM and 6 AM) from our base in Deinze. Loading is not necessary – your truck is already prepared the night before. You follow a fixed route for a regular customer. On average, you make 4 to 6 deliveries per day across the Benelux.
  • You are responsible for unloading the goods yourself using the Moffett forklift attached to your truck. Our dispatch team is always ready to support you in case of questions, delays, or unexpected situations.
  • Finished with your deliveries? Then you drive back to Deinze – job done!

Interested?
Send your CV to Eeklo@absolutejobs.be

What do we expect from you?

  • You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done
  • Physical work is part of the job for you – not an obstacle
  • You have your own transportation, as the truck stays on our premises
  • You can communicate fluently in Dutch, French, or English
  • You're a team player who’s ready to help out where needed
  • You keep your truck and trailer clean and tidy
  • You maintain clear communication with dispatch and other departments

Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly? As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:00 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.
(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

Opportunity

€63,000–€95,000 gross/year · Hybrid (2 days on-site per week, at client premises or company office; 3 days from home) · Permanent, full-time

The systems that track assets, flag maintenance needs and inform mission readiness do not run on gut feeling, they run on clean data and sharp analysis. As Analytics Engineer you will split your time between being embedded at a defence customer site as part of a structured Forward Deployed Engineer team and contributing to the Product Engineering Team, turning raw operational data into the dashboards and insights that operational teams actually rely on. The rotation structure means you carry real on-site ownership while a full team provides backup and coverage; you are not alone.

Your Mission

• Own the SQL layer end-to-end, from raw source data through to production-ready models, with performance and maintainability as the standard.
• Build and maintain analytical and dimensional models that underpin asset tracking, maintenance workflows, readiness reporting and mission planning, datasets that operational teams act on, not prototypes.
• Author and publish dashboards and views in close cooperation with client stakeholders, translating operational requirements into analytical deliverables that are clear, accurate and fit for a defence environment.
• Apply Python for data transformation, lightweight analysis and integration glue work, keeping pipelines reliable and documented.
• Elicit and interpret requirements directly from French- and Dutch-speaking client teams when forward deployed, then translate those needs into concrete analytical outputs.
• Own testing and technical documentation during on-site rotations, with clean handover to the wider engineering, testing and documentation teams between deployments.

What success looks like

Over time, the client teams you support will reach for your dashboards first because the data behind them is trustworthy and the models are built to last. Requirements you gather on-site translate cleanly into working deliverables. Domain experts recognise that you understood what they needed — not just what they said. The components you build are documented well enough that the wider team can maintain, extend and take them into operational use without relying on your recall.

What you bring

• Production-grade SQL, complex transformations, modelling and query optimisation, not basic retrieval.
• Practical Python scripting for ETL, data transformation, analysis and automation; this is not a software engineering role, but the code you write must be clean and maintainable.
• Analytical and dimensional modelling at mid-to-senior level — this is the core technical differentiator for the role.
• Dashboard authoring experience in at least one BI or analytical tool; you will work with proprietary tooling here and ramp up on it after joining, so transferable experience is what counts.
• Consulting and requirements-gathering skills, when forward deployed you are the primary client interface, and the ability to elicit, interpret and translate operational requirements is essential.
• Professional working proficiency in French, Dutch and English — you will conduct requirements discussions in both French and Dutch and coordinate in English; all three are required for delivery and this is not flexible.
• Git discipline and comfort working in structured, security-conscious environments with the composure that client-facing work in defence demands.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role (we support candidates through the clearance process).
The language requirement and clearance eligibility are firm; for everything else, we consider the overall strength of your experience.

Nice to have

• Experience working with logistics, maintenance, asset-management or defence-operations data.
• Prior experience with Oracle or PostgreSQL in a data modelling or transformation context

jobs.occupation: Senior Chief Information Security Officer – ISO 27001 & Risk Governance
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Develop and operationalize the cybersecurity strategy and multi-year program to enhance organizational resilience.
• Integrate cyber risks into the broader Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework and strategic decision-making processes.
• Lead the implementation of Security by Design across digital transformation, cloud, and AI initiatives.
• Maintain the Information Security Management System (ISMS) and governance framework in alignment with international standards.
• Report on risk profiles, maturity levels, and investment needs to executive management and the Board of Directors.
• Foster a security-aware culture by building coalitions and empowering a network of security champions.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security management, or cyber risk governance.
• You bring proven experience as a CISO or senior cybersecurity advisor managing large-scale transformation programs.
• You possess expert knowledge of ISO 27001, NIS2, and GDPR compliance frameworks.
• You have technical proficiency in evaluating risk analyses, penetration tests, and security assessments.
• You bring broad knowledge of IAM, Data Protection, and DevSecOps methodologies.
• You possess experience reporting to executive boards and audit committees regarding security posture and risk.
• You're skilled in stakeholder management and translating technical risks into clear business impact.
• You're proactive and hands-on, capable of driving cultural change and advisory deliverables.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with cloud transformation, data platforms, or AI initiatives.
• Professional certifications such as CISM, CISA, or CISSP.

Responsibilities

• Define the technical vision and lead architecture design for the product in alignment with enterprise guidelines.
• Translate complex business requirements into robust, secure, and high-performing technical solutions.
• Collaborate with Enterprise Architects to ensure integration consistency across the application landscape.
• Provide technical mentorship and architectural guidance to Agile development squads.
• Review data models and solution designs to verify adherence to architectural principles and best practices.
• Identify and mitigate technical risks to ensure product stability and performance.

Requirements

• 7+ years in Software Architecture and object-oriented design including event-driven patterns.
• 7+ years backend development with Java, Spring Framework, and Maven.
• 7+ years experience with IBM MQ, IIB, and AS400 integration patterns.
• 7+ years in data and integration using REST APIs and SQL.
• 5+ years working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (CRM/CE) and enterprise modules.
• Experience with Azure cloud services and modern integration frameworks.
• Experience working in Agile environments.
• Possession of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Unified Operations Core certification.
• Strategic mindset with strong communication skills to influence stakeholders.
• You are fluent in French with a professional level of English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of data management and governance.
• Knowledge of Dutch.
